title: Bag clip
about: a 110 mm bag clip: a hexagonal rod and a slotted sleeve on one plate, the bore sized by a fit class
tries: Make a 60 mm clip for a coffee bag and a 160 mm one for cereal in one print job | Add a loop on the rod's handle so the clip hangs on a hook

agent.role: a designer of kitchen clips who sizes sliding parts from fit classes
agent.prompt: Prefer changing the shared params so both parts follow; keep the slot narrower than the rod across its flats; never draw a clearance by hand when j.fit.hole can size it.

fragments.fit: If the sleeve is hard to slide, raise bag by 0.1 mm at a time rather than changing the fit class.
fragments.batch: To print several clips, add them to the job with .add(name, part, { qty }) and report the plate count.
